name: 28 (2026-11-26 afternoon)
what: Track A: the half-amplitude triaxial run, the Szekeres member, the particle-number leg, and its G2 package; Track B: the mesh leg in the shifted gauge and its G2 package
note: Release core-v0.8 is on main since 2026-11-26 (CLAUDE.md row; executables .work/build_gpu_v08 and .work/build_cpu_v08; the orchestrator's note to all of that day): new runs use it; horizon masses are compared across builds only with the finder's polishing (<fastflow> polish_iterations_<n> = 100 with mass_tol_<n> = 1e-5). After git merge main: nrpic-run finish closes runs continued in place; finish and verify keep a checksum cache (the first pass reads everything once: start it in the background and do not wait; one pass with --full before a gate review). The week's usage is tight: keep to the time given, read what the task needs. Close a finished run before you analyse it; every number with its run id; prediction before every new run; figures made by registered scripts and looked at; at most 6 cores.

items.extra: Extra for this session (about seventy-five minutes).
